qualitative_review: Directly tests whether the S6-S9 fork is universal or a modern-codification artefact on dated pre-modern instruments; explicit recurrence thresholds make both outcomes belief-shifting.
uncertainties: Language coverage (Latin/Ottoman/Arabic/Ge'ez) and translation blur may block a 30-instrument sample; failing that threshold would drop feasibility to 2.

qualitative_review: Converts the repo's admitted no-kappa gap into a measured per-slot agreement figure and localises fuzzy slot boundaries; the outcome is partly predictable from the stated definitions.
uncertainties: Weak Arabic/Thai/Han tagger coverage could make kappa a model-quality artefact; gloss-blind leakage would drop rigor to 3.

qualitative_review: Gives the clearest structural finding a real document-level denominator across scripts; a structured nonzero co-occurrence cluster would rescope the fork to subgenres.
uncertainties: Extraction/OCR quality and tagger accuracy at scale are unverified; detection failure in two script families would leave the claim untested rather than refuted.

qualitative_review: Adds a semantic layer to the citation gate via verbatim quote matching; mostly integrity tooling whose high support rate is predictable from the ledger's existing discipline.
uncertainties: Cross-lingual entailment quality on cheap models is unverified; agreement no better than chance on the 15-claim subsample would drop rigor to 2.

qualitative_review: First quantitative per-slot functional-value profile, reusing the experiment harness with sham controls; asks directly whether the universal stem is load-bearing.
uncertainties: Ablated or template-instantiated texts may lack ecological validity and layout-only slots are untestable; a failed sham control would cap rigor at 3.

qualitative_review: Adds a pre-registered processing-cost outcome that can move under the accuracy ceiling, giving finding 5 its first positive-or-null cost signal.
uncertainties: rt_ms granularity and browser noise are unverified; ethics-review timing for the confirmatory human version could push feasibility to 1.

qualitative_review: Turns the unmeasured efficiency claim into entropy and redundancy figures over frozen data; the S12/S14 dominance prediction is fairly predictable from existing counts.
uncertainties: Mutual-information estimators are biased at n=25; if permutation nulls swallow every effect the idea dies honestly and information gain falls to 2.

qualitative_review: Gives a true within-standard longitudinal series separating the identifier trend from bin composition; retrieval of superseded editions is the make-or-break step.
uncertainties: Paywalled or missing older editions are a known repo risk; retrieval failure would drop feasibility to 1 and reduce the series to anecdote.

qualitative_review: Tests diversity section 7's slot-migration mechanism on one observed reform trajectory; informative, but a single-country case supports a mechanism claim only.
uncertainties: Older Ukrainian and Soviet standard texts may be unreachable; if only the post-2020 edition is retrievable the design collapses to a cross-section.

qualitative_review: Adds a grammar-based citizen-supplied-requisite burden count for UA/EE/DE; a one-service pilot whose expected ordering is largely predicted by the repo narrative.
uncertainties: Portal geo-restrictions and non-comparable entitlements across countries; failing to match the same service in all three would drop feasibility to 2.

qualitative_review: Measures the acknowledged no-kappa gap on all four hand-coded layers and propagates measured error into every headline figure; null and failure outcomes are both informative.
uncertainties: An LLM second coder may not bound human-human kappa; if machine agreement inflates reliability the propagation rests on a bad error rate, rigor to 3.

qualitative_review: Regrades the perfect structural rules from census statements to population inference with exact nulls and FDR; the worked per-edge example already suggests support is joint not per-edge.
uncertainties: Exchangeability of 25 systems under the null is contestable; a tradition-blocked null reversing the per-edge ranking would change the conclusions.

qualitative_review: Turns headline 3 into a pre-specified variance partition with intervals, forcing genre and tradition to compete on the same data; either outcome rewrites or hardens the headline.
uncertainties: Genre must be hand-coded for about 56 rows and n around 28 gives a coarse permutation distribution; coding drift would cap rigor at 4.

qualitative_review: Recasts universality as an estimate with intervals, leave-one-tranche-out sensitivity and a committed out-of-sample slot prediction made before coding.
uncertainties: Every sampling frame is contestable and the hold-out needs one genuinely uncoded system; retrieval failure would reduce the idea to interval reporting.

qualitative_review: Quantifies whether the registered 10pp SESOI is attainable under ceiling and calibrates items pre-recruitment; gates the human arm rather than testing a substantive claim.
uncertainties: Machine-to-human difficulty invariance is untested; if hold-out machine models fail calibration, information gain drops to 2.

qualitative_review: Converts persistence and appraisal from a one-case aside into a coded 28-system layer with an orthogonality test on the kinds-of-document-law catalogue.
uncertainties: Retention evidence in secondary sources may leave over a third of cells not-found, demoting the layer to a documented gap and dropping rigor to 2.

qualitative_review: Codes all 225 requisites by migration behaviour to quantify the untested carriers-do-not-survive claim; cheap, but a single-coder rubric limits rigor.
uncertainties: Gloss-only local_term cells may have already lost substrate cues; low delayed re-code agreement would disconfirm the rubric and drop rigor to 2.

qualitative_review: Conditions the headline findings on the disclosed grounding tiers via a subset branch in recompute.py; cheap, and both replication and non-replication move belief.
uncertainties: Only about 8-10 primary-anchored slot-coded systems may remain; too small a subset yields an underpowered count table that must not be sold as confirmation.

qualitative_review: Converts the khipu and wampum scoped-by-assertion boundary into a testable medium-neutral record grammar applied to three non-documentary systems.
uncertainties: Both boundary cases rest on encyclopedia-grade sources; thin evidence could make any slot-fill a coder artefact, cutting rigor to 2.

qualitative_review: Proposes a non-state stewardship dimension for the document-law catalogue, a genuine de-centring move; framework existence and non-redundancy with access are unverified.
uncertainties: No search this round: if sovereignty texts are unreachable or all clauses map onto access, information gain drops to 2; consultation triggers the ethics gate.

qualitative_review: Adds a colonial-genealogy variable to the similarity analysis with Ethiopia as a negative control; a measurable test of the continuity narrative rather than new breadth.
uncertainties: Metropole cases for GB/PT/BE are absent and need new case files; if they cannot be sourced within budget, feasibility drops to 2.

qualitative_review: Tests whether inclusion and grounding track open-web retrievability, honestly bounding the atlas's breadth claim; a no-bias verdict still strengthens the coverage defence.
uncertainties: The external universe list requires a deferred search and the retrievability proxy is post hoc; no pre-declared proxy would drop rigor to 2.

qualitative_review: Challenges the two-declension model with a functional deliberative-note class; if a stable third profile exists the famous negation becomes a special case.
uncertainties: Cross-linguistic genre identification by one coder on thin sources; if fewer than five systems contain the genre the hypothesis dies on coverage, not structure.
